about.title: About Me
about.description1: I'm a full-stack developer with a true passion for building things for the web. What really drives me, though, is a deep sense of curiosity and a love for continuous learning. I enjoy diving into the full stack—from crafting intuitive user interfaces on the front-end to architecting robust and scalable systems on the back-end. For me, constantly learning new technologies isn't just a hobby; it's how I ensure that every project I touch is modern, effective, and built to the best of my ability.
